text:
sam (customer): Hey team — spotted something weird with promo credits. Our org org_789 shows available credits 0 in dashboard but invoice #44567 has a line applying SPRING24-001 credits. Balance shows negative for the period. Promo should start 2025-11-01 but it looks like it was applied earlier. Can someone investigate?

alex (support): Sorry about that, Sam. Can you DM org id + account email? Also what time did you first notice this? Any recent key rotation? :thinking_face:

sam (customer): DM'd the details. First saw it this morning ~08:34 UTC. We rotated API keys last week but tests passed. Token usage spiked ~2.1M tokens yesterday.

maria (billing): looping in finance. @chris can you pull invoice 44567 from billing ledger and check the timestamp of the credit application? If the credit was backdated it could cause the invoice mismatch.

chris (eng): On it. I suspect the promo-ingest path might have a timezone bug. Can you run a quick credits API check and paste output?

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/org_789/credits
```

sam (customer): Output pasted: { available_credits: 0, pending_credits: 2000, applied_credits: 2000, last_applied: "2025-10-31T23:58:12Z" } — dashboard UI shows 0 and invoice line shows applied on 2025-11-01T00:05:00Z. So it looks like the backend applied it before the billing window closed.

alex (support): Thanks — that aligns with a race where ingestion set last_applied just before midnight UTC. We'll open an internal ops ticket to adjust the invoice and restore visible credits. For an immediate mitigation we can add a provisional account credit so you aren't charged; Maria can confirm.

maria (billing): We can reverse the misapplied credit on invoice 44567 and post a compensatory credit of $50 as goodwill. Need finance lead approval but I'll start the reversal. Please confirm the exact promo id — SPRING24-001?

sam (customer): Correct, SPRING24-001. Also please confirm the token bucket usage so we can reconcile.

chris (eng): Found the log segment in promo-ingest: `effective_date = parse(promo.start_date).astimezone('US/Pacific')` — DST edge-case caused the effective_date to be converted to PST instead of UTC, so some promos were stamped one day early in UTC. I'll push a hotfix to use UTC-only parsing. Patch will go to staging then prod.

ops-bot: deploy started for promo-ingest @chris (deploy id: promo-20251102-42)

ops-bot: deploy succeeded for promo-ingest @chris (deploy id: promo-20251102-42, 2025-11-02T04:12Z)

chris (eng): Hotfix merged: switch to `parser.parse(...).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` and added unit test for end-of-month promos. Also added guard to not apply credits if billing window end < effective_date.

billing-bot: Created internal ticket BILL-7892 to reverse invoice 44567 and issue provisional credit of 2000 units to org_789.

alex (support): Sam — we'll keep you posted. Expected timeline: provisional credit today, formal invoice reversal in ~2 business days once finance signs off. Apologies for the inconvenience. :pray:

sam (customer): Thanks everyone. Please ping once invoice updated so I can close out reconciliation with accounting.

alex (support): Will do — follow-up here when billing update is complete.
